invariants.rationale: The execute() method from ScheduleCompactionActionExecutor likely returns a non-null Option instance to represent absence/presence of value rather than null itself.
If result is present, then result.get() should not be null by Option contract.
Compaction scheduling requires a valid instant time string that is non-null and non-empty.
Option should not be null; Option.empty() or Option.of is typically used to represent absence or presence.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is necessary to schedule compaction, so context should not be null.
